column2: [intro]
In my childhood, I was bad at music theory
Notes and scales, they felt like an allergy
But I had this desire, this privilege within me
To escape with my voice, without worrying about chords or harmony
I'm not a prodigy, that's clear
No need for virtuosity to endear
Music is just my sphere
Playing, singing, bringing cheer
I never knew how to play any instrument
Guitar, piano, not my talent, not my bent
But with my voice, I work wonders,
I transport you to a magical world, no blunders
I'm not a prodigy, that's clear
No need for virtuosity to endear
Music is just my sphere
Playing, singing, bringing cheer
